name: Venture firm
blurb: The CRM a venture firm runs on, plus the insights, patterns and theses behind its decisions, with every signal tied to the belief it supports or contradicts.
about: A venture firm's CRM, with a place for what a CRM leaves out: how a view forms. It holds the companies, people and deals, what was said and written about them, and the insights, patterns and theses the firm builds from those, so a new company arrives against what the firm already believes. Agents source, brief, chase commitments and draft conclusions on their own branches, and the deal or thesis owner reviews before a merge.
sample: Quito Capital, a fictional AI-infrastructure fund

questions.q: Which active theses has new evidence contradicted?
Before investment committee, what contradicts the assumptions behind this deal?
Who on the team can get an introduction to this founder through someone they know?
What have the portfolio companies reported recently?

search.title: Venture capital CRM with theses, evidence and decisions
search.heading: A venture CRM that holds how a view forms, not just the pipeline
